decision.reason: [ev-b01a3de73bcb] is a one-line changelog entry. It says the Ruler gains the ability to disable the `X-Scope-OrgId` header in remote write requests, so the subject and the "added" change are clear in outline. It does not name the configuration key or flag that turns this on, does not say what the default is or that existing behaviour is unchanged, and does not say which Ruler remote-write setups are affected. For those details it only points to PR 11819, so the evidence cannot support a declarative applicability condition.
